about: The Workbench module registry: the navigation, the Labs view and the datapass.open... commands are built from it.
Families: 'learn' holds the labs where a concept is taught and practised in a guided, bounded setting (exercises,
simulators, notebooks); 'work' holds real-life work: end-to-end projects and the labs where the learner does a
ticket with real tools or a full simulated platform (dbt Core, a real shell and Git, Terraform/Docker/Kubernetes).
To register a new lab: add its id to ModuleId in src/modules.ts, one entry below, its command in package.json
(contributes.commands, same id as 'command'), and its surface in SURFACES in src/webview/WorkbenchApp.tsx.
Entries are shown in this order inside their family. 'icon' is a VS Code codicon name for the Labs view.

families.label: Learn
families.description: Guided labs, exercises and simulators: learn a concept, then practise it.

families.label: Real work
families.description: Projects and ticket-style missions done with real tools or a full simulated platform.

modules.label: Practice
modules.description: LeetCode-style data-engineering exercises using native VS Code files and tests.
highlights: Versioned exercise packs
Native VS Code starter files
Tests, hints and review state

modules.label: Mosaic
modules.description: Flexible multi-pane workspace for local Polars, DuckDB, data and charts.
modules.execution: Real DuckDB SQL + opt-in trusted Python/Polars
highlights: Mosaic notebook/layout core
Polars + DuckDB execution
Data, charts and docs in one workspace

modules.label: SparkLab / ZilaCode
modules.description: Deterministic PySpark DataFrame training without a cluster.
highlights: Bounded PySpark DataFrame API
Deterministic local execution
Physical/cost teaching profiles

modules.label: Airflow Lab
modules.description: Airflow 3 DAG files simulated locally: runs, task states, retries and logs.
highlights: Real Airflow 3 DAG files, parsed not run
Runs, catchup and timetables
Grid, replay, trigger rules and retries

modules.label: Pipeline Lab
modules.description: Visual orchestration of notebooks, SQL, copy and procedure-like activities.
modules.execution: Bounded compiler + real local activity execution
highlights: React Flow orchestration
Notebook / SQL / copy activities
Run history and dependency validation

modules.label: BI Lab
modules.description: Data warehousing on the local DuckDB catalog: star schemas, slowly changing dimensions, SQL lineage and model checks.
highlights: Warehouse SQL runs on DuckDB
Column lineage and impact from the SQL text
Star model checks: keys, grain, SCD2, relationships

modules.label: Cloud Lab
modules.description: Fabric, Azure Data Factory and Synapse pipelines with notebooks and stored procedures, simulated on the local lakehouse.
highlights: Real pipeline JSON for Fabric, ADF and Synapse
Notebooks and stored procedures on the local lakehouse
Product differences made explicit

modules.label: Projects
modules.description: End-to-end projects whose steps are done in the labs, with checkboxes that follow your progress.
modules.execution: Steps verified on your workspace; each check says real, simulated or emulated
highlights: Three stories across every lab
Verified checks apart from ticks by hand
Progress in .datapass/progress.json

modules.label: dbt Lab
modules.description: Real-life dbt: dbt Core and dbt-duckdb in a real terminal on the local catalog, with the run's artifacts.
modules.execution: Real dbt Core in your terminal
highlights: Managed dbt Core + dbt-duckdb, installed on request
Real commands typed in a VS Code terminal
DAG, statuses and failures from target/ artifacts

modules.label: Terminal Lab
modules.description: Real bash, PowerShell and Git in a VS Code terminal: tickets done with your own commands, from moving files to rescuing commits with the reflog.
modules.execution: Your own commands; the result is checked
highlights: Git Bash or bash, pwsh or Windows PowerShell: your choice
Datapass runs none of your commands
A hidden checker reads the folder and its Git repository

modules.label: Infra Lab
modules.description: Terraform on a simulated Azure, Docker and compose, VM monitoring and Kubernetes, typed in one simulated terminal: nothing is provisioned, built or deployed.
modules.execution: Simulated terraform, docker, kubectl and az
highlights: Terraform plan/apply on a simulated azurerm subscription
Docker builds, compose and Kubernetes rollouts simulated
Your HCL, Dockerfiles and manifests are read, never executed

modules.label: Lakehouse Lab
modules.description: Storage layout on real local files: Parquet and Hive partitions, pruning, small files and compaction, then DuckLake snapshots, time travel, schema evolution and MERGE, and appends to a Delta table.
modules.execution: Real DuckDB, DuckLake, Delta and Polars on local files
highlights: Partitions and pruning read from DuckDB's EXPLAIN ANALYZE
File counts and sizes measured on disk
DuckLake snapshots and time travel; Delta read and appended; Iceberg explained

modules.label: API Lab
modules.description: Ingest a REST API into bronze with your own Python: pagination, incremental loads, rate limits, retries and schema drift, against a simulated API served locally.
modules.execution: Simulated API; your ingestion code runs for real (trusted Python)
highlights: A simulated REST API on its own loopback port, with a fictitious key
Your ingest.py runs as real local Python
Checks read the bronze tables and the API's request log
